# 词典 G

## 概述

本页收录以字母 G 开头的实用词汇，按职场与商务、日常与社交、技术相关等场景分组。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，并附易混淆词辨析和高频短语，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇       | 词性  | 含义       | 常见搭配                              | 例句                                                             |
| ---------- | ----- | ---------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| generate   | v.    | 产生、生成 | generate revenue/leads                | The campaign generated over 5,000 new leads.                     |
| governance | n.    | 治理、管控 | data governance, corporate governance | Strong data governance ensures compliance with regulations.      |
| grant      | v./n. | 授予/拨款  | grant access/permission               | The admin granted read-only access to the intern.                |
| grievance  | n.    | 不满、申诉 | file a grievance                      | Employees can file a grievance through the HR portal.            |
| gross      | adj.  | 总的、毛的 | gross profit/revenue                  | Gross revenue increased by 30% year over year.                   |
| guideline  | n.    | 指导方针   | follow guidelines                     | Please follow the brand guidelines when creating assets.         |
| growth     | n.    | 增长       | growth rate, career growth            | The company achieved 40% year-over-year growth.                  |
| guarantee  | v./n. | 保证       | quality guarantee                     | We guarantee a 99.9% uptime for our SaaS product.                |
| gauge      | v./n. | 衡量/标准  | gauge interest/performance            | We sent a survey to gauge user interest in the new feature.      |
| groundwork | n.    | 基础工作   | lay the groundwork                    | The research phase laid the groundwork for the product strategy. |
| grasp      | v./n. | 理解、掌握 | grasp a concept                       | It took me a while to grasp the microservices architecture.      |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇      | 词性 | 含义           | 常见搭配                     | 例句                                                       |
| --------- | ---- | -------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| genuine   | adj. | 真诚的、正品的 | genuine concern/product      | His apology seemed genuine and heartfelt.                  |
| generous  | adj. | 慷慨的         | generous offer/tip           | That was a very generous birthday gift.                    |
| gesture   | n.   | 手势、姿态     | kind gesture, make a gesture | Bringing coffee for everyone was a thoughtful gesture.     |
| grateful  | adj. | 感激的         | grateful for                 | I'm grateful for your help with the move.                  |
| grocery   | n.   | 杂货           | grocery store/shopping       | I need to stop by the grocery store on my way home.        |
| gather    | v.   | 聚集、收集     | gather information/together  | We gathered at the park for a weekend barbecue.            |
| glamorous | adj. | 光鲜的、迷人的 | glamorous lifestyle          | The tech industry is not always as glamorous as it seems.  |
| grumpy    | adj. | 脾气暴躁的     | feel grumpy                  | I get grumpy when I haven't had my morning coffee.         |
| genuine   | adj. | 真正的         | genuine leather/article      | Make sure to buy genuine products from authorized sellers. |
| gratitude | n.   | 感恩           | express gratitude            | She expressed her gratitude to the mentors who helped her. |

## 技术相关

| 词汇               | 词性  | 含义         | 常见搭配                     | 例句                                                        |
| ------------------ | ----- | ------------ | ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| gateway            | n.    | 网关         | API gateway, payment gateway | All requests pass through the API gateway first.            |
| Git                | n.    | 版本控制工具 | Git repository, Git workflow | We use Git for version control across all projects.         |
| global             | adj.  | 全局的       | global variable/scope        | Avoid using global variables to prevent side effects.       |
| GPU                | n.    | 图形处理器   | GPU acceleration             | Model training requires GPU acceleration for speed.         |
| GraphQL            | n.    | 图查询语言   | GraphQL query/schema         | We migrated from REST to GraphQL for more flexible queries. |
| grep               | v./n. | 文本搜索     | grep for a pattern           | I grepped the logs for error messages from last night.      |
| GUI                | n.    | 图形用户界面 | GUI application              | The tool provides both a CLI and a GUI interface.           |
| gzip               | n./v. | 压缩格式     | gzip compression             | Enabling gzip compression reduced page load time by 40%.    |
| garbage collection | n.    | 垃圾回收     | GC pause, trigger GC         | Frequent garbage collection pauses can degrade performance. |
| granularity        | n.    | 粒度         | fine/coarse granularity      | We need finer granularity in our permission system.         |

## 易混淆词辨析

| 词组                   | 区别说明                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| good vs. well          | good 形容词，well 副词。She is a **good** developer. / She codes **well**.                                  |
| go to vs. go for       | go to「去往某地」，go for「去做某事/选择」。**Go to** the office. / **Go for** a walk.                      |
| grow vs. raise         | grow「生长（自发）」，raise「养育/提高（人为）」。Plants **grow**. / **Raise** a concern.                   |
| guarantee vs. warranty | guarantee 更广义「保证」，warranty 通常指产品「保修」。**Guarantee** satisfaction. / One-year **warranty**. |

## 高频短语

| 短语             | 含义       | 例句                                                     |
| ---------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| get back to      | 回复、回到 | Let me get back to you after checking the data.          |
| go ahead         | 继续、请便 | Go ahead and merge the pull request.                     |
| go through       | 经历、检查 | Let's go through the requirements one more time.         |
| give priority to | 优先考虑   | We should give priority to fixing critical bugs.         |
| get the hang of  | 掌握窍门   | It takes a while to get the hang of the new IDE.         |
| gear up          | 准备好     | The team is gearing up for the product launch next week. |
| go live          | 上线       | The new website is scheduled to go live on Monday.       |
| get around to    | 抽出时间做 | I haven't gotten around to reviewing that PR yet.        |

## 补充词汇

| 词汇      | 词性  | 含义        | 常见搭配                      |
| --------- | ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------- |
| generic   | adj.  | 通用的      | generic type/component        |
| graceful  | adj.  | 优雅的      | graceful shutdown/degradation |
| glitch    | n.    | 小故障      | UI glitch/system glitch       |
| gitignore | n.    | Git忽略文件 | add to .gitignore             |
| goroutine | n.    | Go协程      | spawn a goroutine             |
| guard     | n./v. | 守卫/保护   | type guard, route guard       |
